messages:
Maya: Kickoff — HyperNode GCP Frankfurt onboarding. Need to coordinate marketplace listing, quota bump, and a capacity safety pool for first 30 days. Partner expects go-live window: 2025-06-10 to 2025-06-17. Please confirm owners.

Jonas: I can own the GCP quota ask. What's the exact SKU list + zones? GCP support needs project/org + per-zone numbers.

Maya: Partner asked for:
```
- 4 x a2-highgpu-1g (A100) per zone (europe-west3-a,b)
- 8 x n2-highmem-16 (for inference workers)
- static external IPs: 6
- Marketplace listing: Dedicated/Private SKUs
```
Also they want burst capacity to handle onboarding spikes (up to +50%) for first 2 weeks.

Jonas: OK. I'll submit quota case. Anyone have estimated baseline QPS so I can justify the numbers?

Alex (HyperNode): baseline ready — expected 400 rps per customer, first cohort 3 customers -> ~1200 rps. We prefer europe-west3-a,b for latency. Can provide orgID + service account tomorrow.

Priya: Ops checklist: we need KMS integration, SOC2 artifacts, and support runbook. I started a SOC2 doc and sent vendor questionnaire to Alex. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/soc2-onboard

Tomas: I can take KMS hookup. Alex, please share service account email + orgID. Also confirm whether HyperNode uses a separate key ring or wants us to manage keys.

Alex (HyperNode): will share SA + orgID by EOD. They want to manage keys in their KMS; we need cross-project access — I'll include required IAM bindings.

marketplace-bot: Draft listing moved to partners-review queue: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/drafts/hn-frankfurt

Maya: Next steps —
- Jonas: open quota ticket & link to INF JIRA (please include the snippet above) — owner
- Priya: follow up SOC2 vendor questionnaire + confirm retention SLA — owner
- Tomas: KMS onboarding once SA/orgID received
- Alex: send SA/orgID + IAM list
I'll run partner kickoff call Tue 10:00 CET. If any blockers raise now. :rocket:

Jonas: Filed INF-3421 and opened GCP case 1234567890. ETA for quota approval 5-9 business days. I'll update thread when status changes.

Priya: Sent SOC2 questionnaire to Alex. Also flagged encryption-at-rest requirement to legal.

Tomas: SA + orgID received, adding IAM bindings now. Will post confirmation once tested.

Alex (HyperNode): Confirmed. We'll join Tue call. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Maya: perfect — closing this convo for now, will post agenda for Tue. Thanks! :slightly_smiling_face:
